title: Stephanie Alvarado:
headline: An entrepreneurial mindset is a muscle, and NFTE makes it real for kids.
story: Stephanie Alvarado of NFTE talks with a partner at the NFTE office. Her point: a mindset is a muscle. You do not learn it once. You build it again and again, all through childhood.
Then the turn: lessons are everywhere online now, but that is not the same as real impact. NFTE makes it real for the kids. This is NFTE's own voice, national and hopeful. It is not about AI.
